meta_description:
11K likes, 7,463 comments - pinchofyum on October 7, 2026: "Rating the meals I made for my family, as a mom who loves fun food but also wants recipes that are at least a lil bit family friendly! 🙂

I’ve relied heavily on those fall freezer meals lately - several of these ones (muffins, meatballs) were ALREADY MADE IN THE FREEZER, best feeling ever. 

Comment “save” and I’ll send you all these recipes!

WEEKLY AWARDS

🏅 My favorite: crispy chicken w creamy beans

🏅 Kids’ favorites (there were many!!): ricotta meatballs, apple crisp, pumpkin muffins 

🏅 Husband’s favorites: chicken with cajun sauce, apple crisp

Have a great week! ❤️".
